files.description: Main EHI Patient Export Specifications document (167 pages). Contains CSV Files Dictionary (441 tables, 4453 fields), Data Schema (574 relationships), Translations (1157 value sets), Patient Documents path instructions, and Glossary. Version 6.5.3.20251230, dated 2025-12-30.
files.curl_command: curl -sL -H 'User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36' -o gGastro-EHI-Patient-Export-Specifications.pdf 'https://www.modmed.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/crp-13761-gGastro-EHI-Patient-Export-Specifications.pdf'

files.description: Additional EHI Patient Export Specifications (551 pages). Contains two large translation tables (Occupation and Occupation Industry) that were too large for the main document. These are GUID-to-value lookup tables for patient occupation tracking.

files.description: Full-page screenshot of the ONC Certification page showing the EHI Export Documentation section and links.
Bun TypeScript script that parses the pdftotext-extracted text from the main PDF and produces structured JSON. Extracts tables, fields, relationships, translations, and glossary.
Structured JSON extraction from the main PDF. Contains 441 tables (4453 fields), 574 relationships, 1157 translation tables (5757 entries), and 23 glossary terms. Machine-queryable format.
Text extracted from the main PDF using pdftotext -layout. Input for the enrichment script.
Text extracted from the Additional PDF using pdftotext -layout. Contains Occupation and Occupation Industry translation tables.
Documentation for the enrichment scripts: run commands, input boundary, output files, and known parsing limitations.
